paper.title: Minimal Exploration in Structured Stochastic Bandits

unmapped: Observation Y(x,t) ~ nu(theta(x)) from a known general parametric family; reward mu(x,theta) is deterministic, known function, unobserved
theta lies in a known compact set Theta encoding the structure
settings.definition_quote: In each round, the decision maker selects an arm from a finite set $\cX$. Each arm $x\in\cX$ has an unknown parameter $\theta(x)\in \mathbb{R}$, and when this arm is chosen in round $t$, the decision maker observes a real-valued random variable $Y(x,t)$ with expectation $\theta(x)$ and distribution $\nu(\theta(x))$. ... The parameter $\theta$ lies in a compact set $\Theta$ that encodes the structural properties of the problem.

source.label: th:low
source.quote: Let $\pi\in \Pi$ be a uniformly good algorithm. For any $\theta\in \Theta$, we have: \lim\inf_{T\to\infty} \frac{R^\pi(T,\theta)}{\ln~T} \ge C(\theta), where $C(\theta)$ is the value of the optimization problem: minimize \sum_x \eta(x)(\mu^\star(\theta)-\mu(x,\theta)) subject to \sum_x \eta(x) D(\theta,\lambda,x) \ge 1, \forall \lambda \in \Lambda(\theta)

results.notes: C(theta) is the Graves-Lai semi-infinite LP value (C_lin). Proof applies Graves & Lai (1997); appendix has a typo (<=). Regret is defined through means, hence pseudo-regret.

symbols.F_eps_gamma: function F(epsilon,gamma,theta) -> 1 as epsilon, gamma -> 0; the proof gives (1 + 2*epsilon*psi(theta)/C(theta))*(1+gamma)

conditions: Assumption 4: KL divergence continuous where finite
Assumption 6: unique solution of the optimization problem

source.label: th:optimal
source.quote: If Assumptions~\ref{ass:unique}, \ref{as:div_continuous}, \ref{as:mu_continuous} and \ref{ass:unique_sol} hold and either Assumption~\ref{ass:bernoulli} or \ref{ass:gaussian} holds, then under the algorithm $\pi=$OSSB($\varepsilon,\gamma$) with $\varepsilon < {1 \over |\cX|}$ we have: \lim\sup_{T\to\infty} {R^\pi(T) \over \ln~T} \le C(\theta) F(\varepsilon,\gamma,\theta), with $F$ a function such that for all $\theta$, we have $F(\varepsilon,\gamma,\theta) \to 1$ as $\varepsilon\to 0$ and $\gamma \to 0$.

results.notes: Bernoulli case of Theorem 2. Appendix gives the explicit limsup <= (C(theta) + 2 eps psi(theta))(1+gamma), psi(theta)=|X| ||c(theta)||_inf sum_x Delta(theta,x).

symbols.F_eps_gamma: function F(epsilon,gamma,theta) -> 1 as epsilon, gamma -> 0; the proof gives (1 + 2*epsilon*psi(theta)/C(theta))*(1+gamma)

conditions: Assumption 4: KL divergence continuous where finite

source.quote: If Assumptions ... hold and either Assumption~\ref{ass:bernoulli} or \ref{ass:gaussian} holds, then under the algorithm $\pi=$OSSB($\varepsilon,\gamma$) with $\varepsilon < {1 \over |\cX|}$ we have: \lim\sup_{T\to\infty} {R^\pi(T) \over \ln~T} \le C(\theta) F(\varepsilon,\gamma,\theta)

symbols.G_fn: finite function G(gamma,|X|) from the concentration lemma
symbols.delta_kappa: delta(kappa)>0 such that ||theta-lambda||_inf <= delta(kappa) implies C(lambda) <= (1+kappa)C(theta), psi(lambda)<=2psi(theta), same optimal arm

source.quote: Putting everything together we obtain the finite-time regret upper bound: R^{\pi}(T) \le \mu^\star(\theta) \left( G(\gamma,|\cX|) + {2 |\cX| \over \varepsilon \delta^2(\kappa)}\right) + (C(\theta)(1 + \kappa) + 2 \varepsilon \psi(\theta) ) (1+\gamma) \ln~T.

results.notes: Not a formal theorem environment; stated in Section 6 text and appendix proof. K denotes |X|. G and delta(kappa) are not explicit.
